hooks.command: file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty'); if echo "$file" | grep -q '\.rs$'; then cargo clippy --quiet 2>&1 | head -30; fi
file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty'); if echo "$file" | grep -q '\.rs$'; then cargo fmt --quiet; fi

file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty'); if echo "$file" | grep -qE '/\.claude/rules/'; then echo 'Reminder: .github/instructions/ counterpart may need updating — run /copilot-sync'; fi

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": "Hard rules: never write unencrypted sensitive data to disk. Never commit secrets. cargo fmt --all after Rust changes. Do not git add/commit — user handles it. master_key must not escape ceremony function body."}'

msg=$(jq -r '.prompt // empty'); if echo "$msg" | grep -qiE 'ceremon|create_vault|change_password|rotate_key'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": "Reminder: master_key must not escape ceremony function body — bind as Zeroizing<[u8;32]> locally only."}'; elif echo "$msg" | grep -qiE 'recovery|phrase|bip.?39|recover_with'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": "Reminder: BIP-39 only; AAD = b\\"arx-runa recovery v1\\" || vault_id_bytes; phrase returned once in Zeroizing<String>."}'; elif echo "$msg" | grep -qiE 'session|reset_timer|begin_operation|lock'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": "Reminder: reset_timer() on every IPC dispatch; begin_operation() guard for long ops; SessionEvent must never contain secret material."}'; elif echo "$msg" | grep -qiE 'aad|nonce|chunk.*(encrypt|decrypt)|xchacha'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": "Reminder: AAD = file_id || chunk_index (big-endian); 24-byte CSPRNG nonce per chunk; verify_checksum before decrypt_chunk."}'; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'curl[[:space:]]+.+\|[[:space:]]*(ba)?sh|wget[[:space:]]+.+\|[[:space:]]*(ba)?sh'; then echo 'Blocked: pipe-to-shell pattern rejected'; exit 2; fi
path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty'); if echo "$path" | grep -qE '(\.env$|\.env\.|/secrets/)'; then echo 'Blocked: sensitive file access rejected by hook'; exit 2; fi
